name: phone-torrent-server
description: A real BitTorrent client with an HTTP API, for the swarms a browser cannot reach.
_overrides_note: webtorrent 2.8 hands parse-torrent's hex-string info hash to uint8-util's arr2hex, which from 2.3 accepts only a typed array — a fresh install of the two therefore throws on the first add. 2.2.5 is the last one that works with it.
